verdict.summary: The merge_group override is correctly given highest precedence in the reusable selector workflow, passes --full while retaining the revision-pair shape, and leaves pull_request label/shadow behavior unchanged. The executable wiring tests are non-vacuous: they run the actual shell body, verify the selector invocation and precedence, feed its argv into the real selector, and confirm mode=full with the complete workspace membership. The caller-coverage assertions also pin the two merge-group workflows. Documentation accurately records the safe rollout ordering and explicitly distinguishes the remaining independently justified queue reductions.
